payer_policy.§1 Codes: Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43775) and laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (CPT 43644).
payer_policy.§2 Eligibility: Adult members with a documented BMI of 40 or greater, or a documented BMI of 35 or greater with at least one obesity-related comorbidity listed in the medical record.
payer_policy.§3 Pre-operative program: (a) Participation in a physician-supervised or registered-dietitian-supervised weight management program, documented by program notes from at least three separate visits; commercial apps or self-directed diets do not qualify. (b) A psychological evaluation by a licensed behavioral health clinician performed for this surgical episode. (c) A nutrition evaluation by a registered dietitian.
payer_policy.§4 Exception: §3(a) is waived when the member has already had a covered bariatric procedure and is requesting a revision for a documented surgical complication.
payer_policy.§5 Documentation: The surgeon's letter alone does not document §3 elements; the underlying notes or evaluations must be attached.
payer_policy.§6 Site: Procedures must be performed at a plan-designated Bariatric Center of Excellence.
payer_policy.§7 Revisions: Revision requests for weight regain alone, without a surgical complication, are not covered.
